Strict positivity A,B,C proves one fixed-kappa dephasing optimum for p<1, strict downward dependence on kappa, sharp limits, and a unique joint optimum by positive-definite Hessian and coercivity. Independent full-state superoperator solves passed 108 cases; 11 exact symbolic identities and 30 optimum tests passed; the infinite-domain proof is analytic rather than inferred from finite tests.
